main_measure.name: mean unusual next-day move on short cases (return minus coin drift, short direction)

statistic.name: t of the mean, cases pooled by day

main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with day-pooled t >= 2 on >= 30 case-days and check passes; reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2 on >= 30 case-days

supporting_check.name: mean unusual move, larger-size half minus smaller-size half

decided_by: t >= 2 but the supporting check fails (larger-size half minus smaller-size half not above 0).
reading: Cases are short bets per the holding-period rule (forecast magnitude rising >= 2 from its lowest level since the last bet, from 0 after flat); the t is cluster-robust with deviations summed per UTC day; the larger half is size above the median |forecast|, the smaller half at or below it; for the situation check the falling profile is 60-bar change in percent < -10 and conditions not computable from a window's prices fall back to the recorded regime.
